mission_09: You have implemented online meta-learning, enabling continuous adaptation to a stream of tasks. The online update paradigm — adapt to each task, then update meta-parameters — allows the model to improve over time without batch training. Regret analysis provides theoretical guarantees: sublinear regret means the algorithm's average performance converges to the best fixed model. Experience replay mitigates catastrophic forgetting by periodically revisiting past tasks, a technique borrowed from continual learning. Adaptive learning rates respond to the difficulty of incoming tasks, enabling faster learning when needed and stability when performance is good. Online meta-learning is the foundation for real-world systems that must continuously improve: recommendation systems that adapt to changing user preferences, autonomous agents that learn from experience, and personalization systems that evolve with each interaction.
